[[File:Airscrubber - SWTVE.png|thumb|An air scrubber|269x269px]]
{{Quote|Sure, we'll let you come aboard for an inspection. But let me warn you, it'll take some time to get that vohis mold stink out of your airscrubbers.|A [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]]|<ref name="Platt's Smugglers Guide">''[[Platt's Smugglers Guide]]''</ref>}}
An '''air scrubber''' was a device used on [[Starship/Legends|starships]] to recirculate the air. Air scrubbers would be more or less efficient depending how many people were on a starship.

During the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] installed better air scrubbers on the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] due to the large number of refugees Solo transported increasing demands on the ''Falcon's'' systems.<ref name="BP">''[[The New Jedi Order: Balance Point]]''</ref>
